awards.line: Bryan Woo worked 5.1 IP, allowing 10 H, 3 R (3 ER) and 1 BB with 4 K.

paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 2 clubs, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.
He batted second and started at third base.
Minnesota Twins beat Los Angeles Angels, 3-0.

Bryan Woo started on the mound for Seattle Mariners. He worked 5 1/3 innings, allowing 10 hits and 3 earned runs, with 1 walk and 4 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the first on a 1-2 98 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Jake McCarthy. Seattle Mariners beat Colorado Rockies, 5-4.
title: Brooks Lee highlights a busy Friday for former Mustangs
